The LLM-as-judge prompt shown is for how Generative RMs work internally, not for evaluating the reward models themselves. The paper evaluates reward models using accuracy metrics, not by using separate LLMs as judges to evaluate the reward model outputs.

overall_notes: The extracted metadata had mostly correct information, but there were some issues: (1) Several languages were incorrectly included that are not part of the 23 languages studied in M-RewardBench; (2) The LLM-as-judge extraction was incorrect - the prompt shown is for how reward models work, not for evaluating them; (3) Some model names needed clarification.
